privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Dancing Atlas is a private demonstration. It has no accounts and asks for no personal information. The dances you save stay in this browser only. Videos are played by YouTube; the dance library and the Viral list are read from GitHub. Like any website, these services and the host of this site receive the technical information a browser sends when it loads a page.

mentor.lead: BDF is not built yet. First it has to learn how the best teachers teach. Every night, at no cost, a machine watches the lessons that learners praise most, reads what learners write and reads the research. This page shows what it has learned so far.

vision.title: What Dance Atlas is preparing
vision.lead: Dance Atlas is the library being prepared for BDF, the Best Dance Friend: a mentor you talk with and move with, who draws on everything known about a dance and on everything known about how to teach it. BDF is not built yet. What you see on this site is the knowledge it will stand on.

words.title: In the founder's words
words.one: We need to be cutting edge with our knowledge of the dance and the education of it, and be ready for the breakthrough in the technology, and then just overnight activate all the profiles.
words.two: Once we teach people to teach in the best way, they become better people, because they can teach. Not only dance: through learning movement we can instil the foundations of mentoring, and they take that with them into life.

now.title: Now
now.body: Gather the knowledge. Every night, at no cost, a machine researches the world's dances, studies lessons and performances, and reads how the best teachers teach.
now.mission1: Mission 1: thousands of dances at the starting line, ready to be switched on.
now.mission2: Mission 2: the mentor's DNA, an endless study of how to teach anyone to dance.

next.title: Next
next.body: A beta for people who live dance culture and music: to look, to check and to correct, together with the founder.

later.title: Later
later.body: BDF itself: a full conversation, in virtual and augmented reality. Seeing the other friends who are learning the same dance, lessons taken together, practising together, a community built on dance.

mentor.title: Why a mentor
mentor.body: The mentor has to come out of the most serious research into how to teach: how to create ease and openness, and an experience that inspires, because it joins learning with movement, with knowledge and with other people. The research does not end, and what it finds becomes knowledge the mentor uses.

not_here.title: What you will not find here
not_here.body: No course, no price, no sign-in. Nothing is for sale and nothing asks for your details. There are no click-through lessons either: that is not how people will enjoy learning to dance.

sacred.title: Sacred and restricted dances
sacred.body: Their story is told with care. They are not taught.

agents.title: Open to any AI
agents.body: The whole library is a set of open files that any agent can read through one documented door: where to start, the rules, an index, and one complete file for every dance.

vision.honesty: Everything here was gathered and written by a machine from public sources and checked against them. It has not been reviewed by a person.

learner_as_dancer.name: הלומד כבר רקדן
learner_as_dancer.do: להתייחס ללומד כאל רקדן מהדקה הראשונה.
learner_as_dancer.meaning: מתייחסים ללומד כאל רקדן כבר עכשיו: "אתה רוקד", "הסגנון שלך"

long_road.name: הדרך הארוכה
long_road.do: להראות את הדרך שלפנינו, וכמה זמן היא לוקחת באמת.
long_road.meaning: הדרך שלפנינו: לאן זה מוביל, כמה זמן זה לוקח באמת, סבלנות

checks_in.name: לעצור ולשים לב
checks_in.do: לבקש מהלומד לשים לב איך זה הרגיש.
checks_in.meaning: הלומד מתבקש לשים לב: איך זה הרגיש, איפה המשקל, מה השתנה

rest_and_kindness.name: מנוחה וטוב לב
rest_and_kindness.meaning: רשות לעצור, לנשום או להפסיק להיום. טוב לב כלפי עצמך

moment_of_presence.name: רגע של נוכחות
moment_of_presence.do: לפתוח או לסגור ברגע של הגעה: נשימה, מוזיקה, תודה.
moment_of_presence.meaning: רגע להגיע, לפני הריקוד או אחריו: נשימה, שקט, הקשבה למוזיקה, הכרת תודה

teach_back.name: ללמד הלאה
teach_back.do: לבקש מהלומד להראות את הצעד לאדם אחר.
teach_back.meaning: הלומד מתבקש להראות, להסביר או ללמד את הצעד לאדם אחר: בן זוג, חבר, המצלמה

method_made_visible.name: השיטה גלויה
method_made_visible.do: לומר למה מלמדים כך, כדי שהלומד יוכל להעביר את זה הלאה.
method_made_visible.meaning: המורה אומר למה הוא מלמד כך, כדי שהלומד יוכל לעשות אותו דבר לאחרים

learner.which feeling comes up, and what answere: איזו תחושה עולה, ומה ענה לה
learner.how much talk and how much movement they: כמה דיבור וכמה תנועה מתאימים לו
learner.their body, their room and whether they: הגוף שלו, החדר שלו, והאם יש לו בן זוג
